documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Board Meeting
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: During the financial year 2025-26, Amal Ltd reported standalone revenue of INR 8,491 lakh and consolidated revenue of INR 23,964 lakh, driven by an increase in price realisation of its main raw material, sulphur. Profit before tax declined on a standalone and consolidated basis mainly because input cost increases could not be fully absorbed. The company remains debt-free with an increased cash surplus, and the Board recommended a dividend of INR 1.5 per share. Management highlighted ongoing capital expenditure projects, operational improvements, and evaluation of potential growth opportunities. Amal Ltd reported its best-ever consolidated performance in FY 2024-25, with sales increasing by 57% to Rs 135 crore and profit before tax rising 11-fold to Rs 33 crore.

guidance.claim: The company has three key objectives to strengthen itself further, including investing in upgrading the existing manufacturing facility, expanding selected existing products, adding new related products, and strengthening the leadership team.
guidance.quote: At this time, we have three key objectives to strengthen our Company further: • One, to invest in upgrading the existing manufacturing facility – two CapEx proposals of ` 6 cr are underway. • Two, to expand (selected existing products) and add new related products. • Three, to further strengthen the leadership team to secure future growth.
